name: igis-kamco-pptx-template
description: Builds the KAMCO proposal PowerPoint template and sample deck from ../../tokens.json

scripts.build: node build-template.js ../IGIS-KAMCO-sample-deck.pptx && python3 postprocess.py ../IGIS-KAMCO-sample-deck.pptx && node build-template.js ../.layouts.pptx --layouts-only && python3 postprocess.py ../.layouts.pptx --potx ../IGIS-KAMCO-template.potx
